summary: Discard obsolete project-local candidate installs inside bubblewrap so pnpm cannot retain their old CAS through its already-up-to-date fast path.

compatibility.detail: Only generated candidate node_modules trees containing the obsolete local store are discarded before a sandboxed reinstall with the configured external store.

manual.detail: Cutover is automatic inside candidate confinement.

recovery.detail: Generated installs can be recreated from the frozen lockfile.
